# PDF Metadata Editor

> A free, 100% client-side web tool for editing PDF metadata directly in the browser.

## What it does

PDF Metadata Editor lets you open a PDF and edit its metadata fields — title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, creation date, and modification date — then download the updated file. Nothing is uploaded to a server; all processing happens locally in the browser via `pdf-lib`.

## Key features

- **Full metadata support**: title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, creation/modification dates
- **100% client-side**: no uploads, no server processing, no data collection, no analytics
- **Drag & drop**: easy file upload
- **Multilingual**: English and Portuguese (Brazil), with persistent language selection
- **Dark theme**: modern, distraction-free UI

## Use cases

- Cleaning or correcting metadata on a PDF before sharing or publishing it
- Adding proper title/author/keywords to improve a PDF's discoverability
- Removing identifying creator/producer info before distributing a document
- Batch-preparing document metadata for archival or compliance purposes

## Limitations

- Cannot edit metadata for password-protected or encrypted PDFs
- One PDF processed at a time
- Advanced XMP metadata is not currently supported

## Technology

Built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and `pdf-lib` for client-side PDF manipulation.
